messages:
maria: quick ask — prepping new model onboarding (gg-13b-lite) for prod. Need a minimal "smokewalk" checklist focused on chat prompt formatting, tool-calling, and structured outputs. any reusable snippets?

sam: +1. here's a tiny chat template we use for tool-calling. keep system msg strict and assistant behavior explicit. paste:
```json
{
  "role": "system",
  "content": "You are a structured assistant. Respond with JSON only. Use keys: action, answer, metadata. If calling tools, put tool_call object."
}
```

anya: quick quant note — q4->q5 sometimes drops NLL on specific prompt shapes. include token-level regression checks and top-k response diffs in smokewalk. Minimal smoke tests I run: 
- prompt roundtrip (user->assistant->parser)
- ascii/json parse check
- tool-call object conformance
- basic semantic similarity sweep (ROUGE/BLEU-ish)

oliver: also add a short curl example for API integration so product teams can copy/paste:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"gg-13b-lite","input":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a structured assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Find top 3 docs about X and call tool."}],"return_structured":true}'
```

dev-bot: CI: model-smokewalk/gg-13b-lite passed 4/6 checks — json-parse failed

qa-bot: json-parse failing because assistant sometimes emits `\"tool_call\": \"search(123)\"` as a string. Enforce schema: tool_call must be an object: {"name":"...", "args":{}}. add lint rule and a tiny unit test.

maria: action items: sam — add template + curl example to repo; anya — add quant smoke tests and top-k diffs; oliver — update evaluator to fail loudly on schema mismatch. I will run a quick eval tomorrow morning.

sam: on it, will PR with template, curl, and a README called smokewalk.md. Keeping examples small.

anya: I'll add these metrics to the onboarding checklist: parse_error_rate < 0.5%, semantic_regression_delta < 2% on our eval set, latency SLOs preserved after quant.

oliver: one more operational note: streaming + function-calls can cut the JSON body mid-stream and break parsers. recommend adding a finalization sentinel and a `stream_end` boolean in the structured contract so consumers can be robust.

maria: good call. include `stream_end: true` as required in the schema and docs.

sam: ack :thumbsup:
